front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original 16-part skeletal game character atlas.
Primary request: Rebuild the Ashen Hearthkin female artisan from reference 1 as beautifully detailed modern game character artwork, exploded into 16 isolated body components for continuous animation. Reference 1 establishes her identity and clothing; reference 2 establishes the modular parts layout and premium surface quality ONLY, not its colors, kerchief or identity.
Subject: capable adult woman about thirty, olive skin, expressive face, dark almost black hair in a long practical braid, NO kerchief. Charcoal linen working blouse with a practical laced neckline, sleeves rolled to elbows; rust-red waist sash, dark leather utility belt; knee-length charcoal split overskirt with a pale ash-linen patched apron, narrow practical trousers and scuffed russet leather boots. Small dark leather bracer on anatomical LEFT forearm, bare RIGHT forearm. Rich woven cloth, seam detail, leather grain; believable sculpted anatomy, premium realistic 3D rendered surfaces with painterly finesse, no hard outlines.
View: FRONT facing the camera, orthographic camera 25 degrees above horizontal. The same view for every part. Arms in natural neutral rotation, elbow crease facing toward torso, forearms hang down. Relaxed curled gripping hands with thumbs toward torso: anatomical LEFT hand (row3 col1) thumb on picture-left edge; RIGHT hand (row3 col2) thumb on picture-right edge. Show narrow three-quarter hand surfaces, not flattened open palms.
Composition: exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 isolated components, each entirely inside its regular cell with generous transparent gutters. No assembled character. All limb shafts straight vertical, down from root joint to tip joint, with softly rounded overlap caps. Garments viewed naturally from stated camera.
Row1: head+neck WITHOUT long braid; sleeveless torso shoulders through waist WITHOUT head or arms; skirt/apron/belt/hip garment WITHOUT legs; detached long dark braid.
Row2: anatomical LEFT upper sleeve/arm shoulder to elbow; RIGHT upper sleeve/arm shoulder to elbow; LEFT forearm elbow to wrist including bracer and NO hand; RIGHT bare forearm elbow to wrist and NO hand.
Row3: LEFT curled relaxed gripping hand+wrist WITHOUT any prop; RIGHT curled relaxed gripping hand+wrist WITHOUT prop; LEFT trouser thigh hip to knee; RIGHT trouser thigh hip to knee.
Row4: LEFT trouser shin knee to ankle; RIGHT trouser shin knee to ankle; LEFT leather boot toe toward camera; RIGHT leather boot toe toward camera.
Lighting: soft warm upper left key, cool ambient bounce, consistent across all pieces.
Constraints: no tools, weapons, cargo or shield anywhere. No blood, internal anatomy, severed effects. No scenery, floor, shadows outside pieces, text, labels, grid, paper or checkerboard. Deliver a PNG with genuine TRANSPARENT ALPHA, ALL blank space alpha zero. Do not draw a background. Fine clean isolated edges.

corrections.front: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied modular Ashen Hearthkin sheet. Change ONLY the two hands in row3 columns1 and2: they must be naturally softly CLOSED hands gently gripping an invisible small vertical tool handle. The wrist hangs straight down with a narrow neutral three-quarter surface; fingers curled, thumb touching curled index finger, not flattened spread knuckles or dangling extended fingers. Match the existing olive skin. Row3col1 is anatomical LEFT hand: thumb on image-left edge. Row3col2 is anatomical RIGHT hand: thumb on image-right edge. Keep hand scale and wrist position. No prop. Preserve all other pieces, all other placement, proportions, color and detail exactly. Extract the entire sheet onto genuine transparent PNG RGBA: remove every checkerboard square to alpha zero. No background, no text.
corrections.back: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied BACK-view modular Ashen Hearthkin sheet. Change ONLY row3 col3 and row3 col4 trouser thighs: each cell must contain ONE isolated trouser THIGH from hip to knee, NOT a pair of shorts and not two legs. Row3col3 is left thigh rear surface, row3col4 right thigh rear surface. Keep their existing height but narrow them to ONE THIGH width. In row1col3 rear skirt, remove the pale apron from rear and show charcoal skirt with rust sash across belt; retain all other colors and detail. All other pieces remain unchanged. Extract entire sheet to genuine transparent PNG RGBA, remove checkerboard to alpha zero. No background, no text.

transparentExtraction:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite sheet
Primary request: Extract all separate character components from the supplied image onto a genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel.
Input image: edit target.
Constraints: keep every component and its placement, detail, color, facing direction and size unchanged. Remove only the painted checkerboard background. Preserve clean edges and all gaps. The output is a transparent cutout PNG, not an illustration of cutouts on paper.
